error_message: Failed to Load Page ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED (-102) at http://localhost:5173/
root_cause: No process was listening on TCP port 5173.
fix: Start the Vite frontend from the client directory and verify that port 5173 responds.

error_message: STATUS.md patch context did not match because the file contains mojibake-encoded heading text.
root_cause: Automated patch context used display-decoded characters that differ from the file's stored text.
fix: Use ASCII-only patch context when editing OpenWolf handoff files with encoding artifacts.

error_message: Unable to sign in. Please try again.
root_cause: The frontend proxies authentication requests to port 5000, but no backend process was listening on that port.
fix: Start the mock API server from the application root and verify the login endpoint.

error_message: Audit module at /audit-module shows no data.
root_cause: The Audit API is configured on port 5002, but no process was listening on that port.
fix: Start the Audit API and confirm its seeded data endpoints respond before performing any destructive reseed.

error_message: tsx watch src/index.ts fails with ERR_SYSTEM_ERROR: uv_os_get_passwd returned ENOMEM.
root_cause: The tsx watch runtime calls Node's os.userInfo(), which fails in this environment with ENOMEM.
fix: Compile with TypeScript and start the generated Node server without tsx watch mode.

error_message: node dist/index.js fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for dist/routes/auditPlans.
root_cause: TypeScript output retains extensionless ESM imports, which Node's ESM resolver does not resolve.
fix: Run the TypeScript entrypoint with the tsx loader instead of using the generated output directly.

error_message: Audit API resource endpoints returned HTTP 500 while health returned HTTP 200.
root_cause: The server was launched with DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db; Prisma resolves this relative to its schema directory, producing a nonexistent nested path.
fix: Launch with DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db, which resolves to the existing prisma/dev.db database.

error_message: Risk asset selection was not enforced as a backend relationship to Asset Management records.
root_cause: The client used assetSystem as an unvalidated string, so the backend did not maintain a durable asset identifier or reject unknown assets.
fix: Store and validate assetId against the Asset Management collection; retain the asset name only as a display value.

error_message: Browser reported ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED for localhost.
root_cause: The Vite frontend and mock API processes were not running.
fix: Started the frontend with npm run dev and the mock API with node mock-server.mjs.

error_message: riskOwnerId must reference an active user when assigning the active lol user.
root_cause: The actual risk creation page used a CreatableSelect whose value was the owner's name, while the API requires the active user's _id.
fix: Use a standard Select filtered to active users and submit each user's _id as riskOwnerId.

error_message: Mail settings showed Connected but sender fields were not loaded and test emails were falsely accepted.
root_cause: The UI and API used different SMTP field names, recent activity used logs instead of items, and the mock test endpoint always returned success.
fix: Align SMTP status/config fields, load recent items, report truthful disconnected status, and reject test sending when no SMTP transport is configured.

error_message: SMTP transport is not enabled in this local mock server.
root_cause: The email test endpoint was a placeholder and always returned HTTP 501 instead of using an SMTP transport.
fix: Installed Nodemailer and implemented SMTP verification and real test-email delivery using the configured mailbox credentials.

error_message: SMTP configuration disappeared after refreshing the Mail settings page or restarting the backend.
root_cause: EMAIL_CONFIG was stored only in the in-memory mock data object.
fix: Persist SMTP configuration to server/data/email-config.json, load it at startup, preserve a saved app password when the password field is left blank, and ignore the file in Git.

error_message: SMTP configuration saved. Verifying connection… remained visible for too long.
root_cause: The UI delayed the status refresh and the SMTP transport allowed a long network timeout.
fix: Await the status check directly, show its result in the UI, and cap SMTP connection/greeting timeouts at 3 seconds.

error_message: ReferenceError: CreatableSelect is not defined on /risk/submit.
root_cause: The Risk Owner field was changed from CreatableSelect to Select, but CreatableSelect was still used by the Risk Owner sign-off field.
fix: Restore the CreatableSelect import while keeping the Risk Owner assignment field as an active-user ID Select.

error_message: R-017 was assigned to an owner with a valid email but no notification was sent.
root_cause: Risk creation did not invoke the SMTP notification service; email settings only configured the transport.
fix: Send a real assignment email after risk creation and provide a manual Notify owner action for existing risks.

error_message: Created risk R-017 disappeared after the mock backend restarted.
root_cause: The RISKS collection was held only in memory and was reinitialized from mock-data.mjs on every server restart.
fix: Persist RISKS to server/data/risks.json on create and update, load the saved collection at startup, and ignore the local file in Git.

error_message: Risk Owner data disappeared after restarting the mock backend.
root_cause: The application used in-memory arrays for all generic models, so writes from any form were lost when the Node process restarted.
fix: Added a centralized JSON database snapshot for all registered collections and nested records, saved after every mutating API request and loaded at startup; protected the local file with .gitignore.

error_message: Risk specification calculation request using criteriaScores and riskControls was rejected or unsupported.
root_cause: The calculation adapter accepted only the UI payload names impacts and linkedControls, while the functional specification uses criteriaScores and riskControls.
fix: Accept both payload shapes and expose POST /api/risks/calculate through the existing RiskEngine pipeline.

error_message: Following Up page was blank: Objects are not valid as a React child.
root_cause: The enriched riskOwner object was rendered directly inside the Owner table cell.
fix: Render riskOwner.name with compatible fallbacks instead of the object value.

error_message: Organization detail displayed all platform risks, assets, and domains.
root_cause: The organization rollup used global collection lengths and persisted records lacked consistent organization links.
fix: Added organization links with persisted-data backfill, filtered rollups and resource lists, and preserved organization query navigation.

error_message: Organization hierarchy displayed only the selected organization without its subsidiaries.
root_cause: The hierarchy endpoint returned the selected organization directly and never constructed children from parentOrg references.
fix: Build a recursive children tree while supporting both string and object parentOrg values.

error_message: Compliance workflow stages were displayed but their state was local and not traceable across the lifecycle.
root_cause: Frameworks, assessments, evidence, gaps, and remediation used transient component state without lifecycle transitions.
fix: Persisted the compliance workspace, linked assessment outcomes to automatic gaps, and linked completed remediation tasks to gap resolution.

error_message: Policy detail uploads, workflow approval, audit history, and control mapping were UI-only or non-functional.
root_cause: Tabs called unsupported methods on the resource helper, Evidence Mapping was redundant, and policy detail lifecycle responses omitted complete policy data.
fix: Switched policy tabs to Axios endpoints, removed Evidence Mapping, added real control dropdowns and links, combined audit records, normalized policy detail state, and preserved document uploads and workflow transitions.

error_message: Additional policy detail tabs used unsupported resource helper methods and did not persist actions.
root_cause: Versions, risk mappings, hierarchy, and attestations called get/create/update/remove on a collection helper instead of the Axios client.
fix: Switched remaining tabs to Axios endpoints, removed the obsolete Evidence Mapping implementation, and validated the complete frontend build.

error_message: RiskMappingsTab.jsx: Uncaught ReferenceError: resource is not defined.
root_cause: The resource import was removed while the risks collection declaration still referenced resource().
fix: Removed the stale collection declaration and loaded risks through the configured Axios client.

error_message: WorkflowTab retained a stale api.put reference after migration to Axios.
root_cause: One workflow stage-save call was not updated with the rest of the API migration.
fix: Changed the call to apiClient.put and verified all policy tabs for stale resource-helper calls.

error_message: Requirement details crashed with ReferenceError: DetailStat is not defined.
root_cause: The relationship detail view referenced a missing wrapper component.
fix: Defined DetailStat and verified the requirement detail drawer in the browser.

error_message: Requirement relationship editor required Ctrl for multi-select and displayed malformed live identifiers.
root_cause: Native multi-select interaction was not discoverable and persisted demo collections contain mixed identifier formats.
fix: Replaced multi-select elements with checkboxes and normalized live options with validated identifier prefixes and seeded fallbacks.

error_message: ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED at http://localhost:5173/
root_cause: The startup script launched from a path containing Arabic characters through cmd quoting, while the required frontend and backend dependencies were not installed in their project directories.
fix: Installed dependencies in the application root and client directories, and changed start.bat to discover the application directory and use start /D for child processes. Verified frontend and login API HTTP 200 responses.

error_message: Audit module at /audit-module could not load data because localhost:5002 refused connection.
root_cause: start.bat started the main API and Vite frontend but omitted the separate Audit API service.
fix: Added Audit API startup via npx tsx src/index.ts and verified health, dashboard, and audit page HTTP 200 responses.

error_message: Audit page /audit-module/audits failed at runtime with a React Query client error.
root_cause: Audit pages called useQuery without a QueryClientProvider, and React Query was not declared as a client dependency.
fix: Added a shared QueryClientProvider around the application and declared @tanstack/react-query in package manifests.

error_message: View button on /audit-module/audits did not open audit details.
root_cause: The existing detail drawer state was never assigned when a row or View button was clicked, and AuditModule did not provide an onOpenAudit callback.
fix: Set the selected audit in the existing detail drawer from row and View button clicks, while preserving the optional callback.
